title: Geneigter Laubbaum B
description: Geneigter Laubbaum mit niedriger ungleicher Zweiergabel und durchgehend verschmolzenen Astkragen. Rekursive Nebenäste tragen eine einseitig aufstrebende, unregelmäßige Laubkrone mit dunklem Inneren und olivgrünen Sonnenflächen.

review.notes: Round 1. Good: 11.2 m high with a 7.3 m crown, modelled leaves, slight trunk lean. Defects: (1) the crown is a closed egg/ball with no lobes and no sky gaps, so it reads as a lollipop; break it into irregular branch clusters with air between them. (2) A single straight trunk runs into the crown with no visible fork or main limbs (STYLE.md: forks and root flares visible). (3) The root flare repeats tree_broadleaf_a's flat star fins. (4) The bark is a smooth tube with no tree_bark furrows. (5) The foliage is dark blue-green, not olive; the tops are barely lighter. Also make it read clearly as a different species from tree_a, not just a smaller copy.
